advance_rule: advance to 16 experts only if validation aggregate improves at least 10 percent versus both Hessian-only trellis and GPTQ NVFP4, with neither projection worse than Hessian-only trellis
algorithm_exclusion: no LDLQ code path, objective, or result is used

candidate.encoder: Viterbi per native 16x16 tile plus full-Hessian GPTQ-style inter-group error feedback and static within-group act order
candidate.rate: K4 plus one UE8M0 byte per 32 weights = 4.25 bpw
candidate.runtime: P8 mxf8f6f4; quality product; twice NVFP4 MMA issue rate

carrier: P8 E4M3 K32 UE8M0 amax pseudoquant
controls: BF16 weight on P8 activation carrier
Hessian-feedback MCG K4 Viterbi without output correction
protected_boundary: selection, confirmation, final, and all 28 confirmation logits remain unopened
role: fit engineering screen; nested split after v1 overfit

sampling.strategy: domain-balanced routed REAP samples per expert

selection_rule: fit corrections only on offset 0; choose one ridge/correction pair by lowest unquantized offset-128 tuning output NMSE; then freeze before offset-256 validation and quantization
